description: Short-lived verified injury context used when offseason structured feeds lack official designations. Each row expires automatically and can explicitly control whether the optional health-adjusted ranking layer moves.

fields.adjust_rank: true applies rank_penalty to the optional health-adjusted layer; false displays context only
fields.rank_penalty: provisional overall ranking slots, never an overwrite of source rankings
fields.expires_at: ISO date after which the override is ignored

Jeremiyah Love.name: Jeremiyah Love
Jeremiyah Love.notes: Ankle injury after 14 preseason carries. The episode treated it as a likely high-ankle concern; the team had not provided a firm long-term timeline. He previously handled 8 of 11 starter snaps with 11 carries and 3 catches.

Breece Hall.name: Breece Hall
Breece Hall.notes: Suffered a non-contact groin strain while running a route. The episode had no confirmed timetable. Before the injury, he played 10 of 11 starter snaps and handled all four backfield opportunities.

Chuba Hubbard.name: Chuba Hubbard
Chuba Hubbard.notes: Did not play and was described as week-to-week with a hamstring issue; Jonathan Brooks handled the starter work.

Emeka Egbuka.name: Emeka Egbuka
Emeka Egbuka.notes: Specialist testing confirmed a stable toe sprain, but Todd Bowles would not confirm Week 1 availability.

George Kittle.name: George Kittle
George Kittle.notes: The team was very confident he would avoid PUP and said he had a chance to play Week 1. The risk of a guaranteed four-game absence declined.

Jordyn Tyson.name: Jordyn Tyson
Jordyn Tyson.notes: New Orleans was still gathering medical opinions. The show used missed early-season games as the working assumption and said surgery remained within the possible range.

Tucker Kraft.name: Tucker Kraft
Tucker Kraft.notes: Returned to practice but described a planned snap count that may extend through roughly half the season.

Christian McCaffrey.name: Christian McCaffrey
Christian McCaffrey.notes: Missed a full week with unspecified tightness. The hosts raised concern but had no confirmed diagnosis.
